# Orphica, cum notis Henrici Stephani, Joh. Matth. Gesneri, Thomae Tyrwhitti, Andreae Christiani Eschenbachii, Ruhnkenii et aliorum; recensuit Godofredus Hermann

- **Title:** Orphica, cum notis Henrici Stephani, Joh. Matth. Gesneri, Thomae Tyrwhitti, Andreae Christiani Eschenbachii, Ruhnkenii et aliorum; recensuit Godofredus Hermann
- **Author:** Orpheus (attributed); edited by Gottfried Hermann
- **Edition:** Leipzig: Fritsch, 1805; Google Books scan on the Internet Archive (item orphica00unkngoog). Greek text of the Hymns, Argonautica, Lithica, De lapidibus and fragments with Latin notes; the edition Taylor translated from. A second scan (bub_gb_i1oNAAAAYAAJ) is kept alongside.
- **Translator:** none
- **Year:** 1805
- **Read from:** https://archive.org/download/orphica00unkngoog/orphica00unkngoog_djvu.txt
- **Date fetched:** 2026-11-21
- **Licence / copyright status:** Public domain (published 1805).
- **Text status:** OCR text of a scan, kept raw (recognition errors, running heads).
